title: Poetry, Bible and Theology from Late Antiquity to the Middle Ages
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This volume examines for the first time the most important methodological issues concerning Christian poetry – i.e. biblical and theological poetry in classical meters – from a diachronic perspective. Thus, it is possible to evaluate the doctrinal significance of these compositions and the role that they play in the development of Christian theological ideas and biblical exegesis.
